Every tile's rotation/offset/z-index is a crc32 hash of the page seed plus the item's own identity, so html-cache serves identical scattered HTML to every visitor. Click-to-front is CSS-only: tabindex + :focus-within/:focus-visible raises a tile's z-index above its scattered siblings without removing it from normal keyboard tab order. Re-scored overlapRisk from medium to low -- the calm/muted styling still shares the inspiration-gallery buyer with field-guide and first-light, but the scatter mechanic is now a genuinely orthogonal, implemented differentiator rather than a stated intention.
